name: catenin beta 1

function.text: CTNNB1 encodes β-catenin, a protein with roles in cell adhesion and canonical Wnt signaling; regulated stabilization permits transcriptional effects through TCF/LEF factors.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to CTNNB1-related neurodevelopmental disorder and/or vitreoretinopathy (autosomal dominant); severe intellectual disability-progressive spastic diplegia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Wilms tumor; Hepatoblastoma; Medulloblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
